note: fn-rcw-acc-step (reclaim-chunked-walk.lisp:73), called once per chunk by passes 2 and 3 (fn-rcw-canon-acc-step :296, fn-rcw-predict-acc-step reclaim-chunked-seal.lisp:60; host/native/owner.lisp:8650, :8712), resumes the configuration fold with fn-rii-sco-cpr-resume, which calls fn-rii-ix-of (replay-identity-index.lisp:606, fn-mxc-build + fn-rii-kbuild) on the accumulated node. Measured fn-rii-ix-of on the laptop: 0.25 s at 100k articles+pins, 1.55 s at 400k, 4.19 s at 1M (build/log-runs/l2bb/ixof-measure.out). Over C chunks a pass pays about C/2 rebuilds of the whole node: at 1M records and about 1,000 records per 4 MiB chunk (C about 1,000), about 35 min per pass and 70 min for passes 2 and 3, against about 4 s for one rebuild; at 100k records about 12 s per pass. The header claim (:25-26) 'so a chunk costs the chunk' is false for the configuration fold. Fix: the accumulator carries the tries (fn-sfi-cpr-resume-carried, store-finalize-incremental.lisp:691), one node pass at the first configured pause; books only, host unchanged; statements build/log-runs/l2bb/rcw-carry-statements-draft0.lisp. Files granted by A 2026-10-10.
title: The reclaim pass rebuilds both id tries from the whole accumulated node on every 4 MiB chunk (quadratic in the chunk count)
